_comment: External benchmarks gathered for the salary guide, with how good each one is.
This file is the audit trail: what we checked, what it said, and how much we
trust it. Nothing here publishes automatically. It feeds content-ops/salary-review.md,
which Eugene reviews, and only what he confirms moves into salary-overrides.json.
primary   - read directly from the issuing agency's own page or dataset
secondary - a figure attributed to an official source but read off a third-party site
blocked   - the official source exists but we could not reach it, figure unverified

community_care_guidelines.caveat: Figures are monthly BASE salary (starting and mid-point of the band), not gross. The document says so explicitly: it 'does not refer to the monthly gross salaries'. ATC is the sector median ANNUAL total compensation, base plus 13th month, bonuses and allowances. Issued jointly by MOH and AIC. The job roles listed are examples and non-exhaustive. The document reminds CCOs to meet the prevailing PWM or Occupational Progressive Wages for Singapore citizens and PRs.

mcf.caveat: Advertised pay, not agreed pay, and it is a basic figure. Understates roles where overtime and allowances carry the package.
mcf.name: MyCareersFuture
mcf.what: Advertised basic salary on live job postings, aggregated to 25th-75th percentile by role and seniority.

mom_ows.caveat: Table 4 read directly 20 Nov 2026 from MOM's own download (mrsd_2025Wages_table4.xlsx, Occupational Wage 2025 Statistical Tables, June 2025). Coverage, from MOM's Coverage and Methodology note: full-time resident employees in private-sector establishments with at least 25 employees (5,230 establishments, about 391,300 employees, 98% response rate), supplemented with administrative records. Excludes apprentices/trainees, temporary, part-time and piece-rated workers, and anyone who worked only part of June 2025. Gross = basic + overtime, commissions and allowances, before employee CPF and tax; it excludes employer CPF, bonuses, stock options, lump sums and payments-in-kind. The earlier second-hand figures were checked against it: RN, pharmacist and physiotherapist matched exactly; healthcare assistant did not.
mom_ows.name: MOM Occupational Wages
mom_ows.what: Median, 25th and 75th percentile gross monthly wage by occupation. Covers 523 occupations. Citizens and PRs only. Gross, before employee CPF and tax, excluding bonuses.
mom_ows.readBy: Muse, from MOM's own Table 4 download

communityCare.note: Recommended starting and mid-point MONTHLY BASE salary, plus median annual total compensation (ATC), for the community care sector. Base, not gross. Job roles are examples of typical titles in the band and are non-exhaustive.
whatItMeansForTheGuide: Care / Support Staff on the guide shows basic $2,500 - $2,900, floored. The guidelines put a Healthcare Assistant / Care Staff at Band 3, starting $2,480 and mid-point $3,300 base. The guide's floored range sits inside Band 3, so the $2,500 basic floor is defensible for this role, but only just: Band 3 starts at $2,480, $20 below the floor.

Clinic Staff on the guide now shows basic $2,500 - $2,900 after the 21 Nov 2026 data refresh (no longer floored). The closest guidelines bands are administrative Band 3 (Assistant / Social Service Assistant, $2,480 - $3,300) and Band 4 (Executive / Social Work Associate, $2,580 - $4,020). The guide's range sits inside those bands.

Patient Service on the guide now shows basic $2,500 - $2,750 after the 21 Nov 2026 data refresh (no longer floored or open-ended). The guidelines' administrative Band 4 (Executive / Social Work Associate) runs $2,580 - $4,020, so the guide's range sits mostly inside Band 4, its bottom just below Band 4's starting point.

The MOM gross median for a healthcare assistant ($2,410, corrected from $2,432 on 20 Nov 2026) still sits below the $2,500 basic floor. This is not like-for-like: gross includes overtime and allowances, basic does not. The point is that healthcare hands-on pay looks like manufacturing, not like logistics.
No guide figure has been changed here. The floor decision is Eugene's, and the numbers above are the evidence for it.

openQuestions: No official source found yet for commercial admin and secretarial.

Our single 'Nurse' row conflates Registered and Enrolled Nurse. The guidelines price them very differently: Staff Nurse (N1C) starts at $2,730 base, Enrolled Nurse (N2B) at $2,050. Worth splitting into two roles.
Clinic Staff and Patient Service are hospital and clinic front-of-house, not community care, so the guidelines do not cover them. Still on advertised data only.
